title: Haneda to Hong Kong, harbour night
summary: What happened. Landed Hong Kong Terminal 1 at 14:30. A relaxed early train to Haneda with the bags, ahead of the morning rush, then the first Hong Kong night on the harbour: watch the 20:00 Symphony of Lights from the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade, with a champagne supper. Skipped the junk boat cruise. No pool today, because the sun is nearly gone by check-in.

rows.detail: Bags packed and the bill settled the night before, so checkout is just handing over the keys.

About 8 to 10 minutes with the bags, east to Shimbashi Station (新橋駅). Follow the 都営浅草線 (Toei Asakusa line) signs and take the lifts (エレベーター) down. Platform 1, toward 西馬込・羽田空港 (Nishi-magome / Haneda Airport). Tap Suica.

エアポート快特 (Airport Rapid Limited Express), the board must say 羽田空港 (Haneda Airport). No changes. Off at 羽田空港第3ターミナル (Haneda Airport Terminal 3), the first airport stop, about 07:05. Roughly ¥550 each on Suica. Missed it? The 06:45 and 06:58 急行 (Express) are just as direct, about 07:17 and 07:30 at T3. All three beat the morning rush, which builds from about 07:30. Never board a train for 西馬込 (Nishi-magome). How-to 18.
Lifts straight up to the 3F departures hall. Plenty of time: grab a coffee before the Cathay desks.

rows.what: Check in at the Cathay desks
rows.detail: Departures 3F. Check the screens for the Cathay Pacific counter for CX543.
Usually quick, but allow for a queue.
Spend leftover yen and IC card balance here.
Terminal 3. Hong Kong is one hour behind Tokyo.
Terminal 1 at 14:30 (planned 14:25). Allow 45 to 60 minutes for immigration, bags and customs. No arrival card needed (How-to 33).

rows.what: Red urban taxi to the Sheraton
rows.detail: From the rank outside Arrivals, RED taxis only. Show: 九龍尖沙咀彌敦道20號 香港喜來登酒店. 35 to 45 minutes, roughly HK$300 to 400 with tolls and bags (est. A$54 to 73). Carry some cash (How-to 33).
Ask two things at the desk: whether pool sessions need booking, and the club lounge hours. Friday's late checkout is already confirmed to 18:00.
Drinks and canapés as the harbour lights come on. Sunset is about 17:50.
Enjoy a champagne supper at the hotel (Sky Lounge or in-room) or nearby in Tsim Sha Tsui, building the evening around the harbour views.

rows.what: Walk to Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade
rows.detail: Five to ten minutes from the hotel to the waterfront promenade facing Hong Kong Island. Arrive early for a good railing spot. Best free view of the show.

rows.what: A Symphony of Lights from the promenade
rows.detail: The nightly harbour light show. Lasers, searchlights and LED screens on the towers along both shores, set to music, for about ten minutes. Watch it free from the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade (Avenue of Stars area). Skipped the Aqua Luna cruise.
Along the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade. Handprints, the Bruce Lee statue and the full Island skyline. Continue the champagne supper vibe if desired.

rows.what: Bar, or Temple Street night market
rows.detail: Only if you have the energy. Or back to the hotel Sky Lounge for more drinks.

notes: If it is pouring, the bags are a pain, or anything looks wrong at the station: taxi from the hotel front desk or rank, about 25 to 30 minutes. Quoted about A$107. Show: 羽田空港 第3ターミナル 出発ロビーまでお願いします。 (Haneda Airport Terminal 3, departures lobby, please.)
Instead of the taxi in Hong Kong
First check whether the Agoda booking includes an airport pickup. Otherwise the Airport Express to Kowloon Station, then a 5 to 10 minute taxi, costs about the same for two with more bag handling.

From the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade, five minutes from the hotel. It faces the Hong Kong Island towers, which is the better side. Your harbour view room faces the same way. Free and easy; arrive by 19:45 for a good spot.
Under an hour late: still fine for the promenade show. Later: watch from the promenade or the Sheraton Sky Lounge.
